answer: Each submission hangs on the nectar of a task receipt, and the gale is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ember of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
